headline: Arsenal fall to Brighton as Kane breaks Bundesliga record
paragraphs: Arsenal's unbeaten Premier League start ended on Saturday, beaten 3-0 at Brighton for their first league defeat of the season. The BBC, the Guardian and Sky Sports each ran independent match reports, and Opta's stats page attributes the result to Brighton's pressing. Manager Mikel Arteta told the BBC his side were 'very far' from the standard required to compete. This is a settled result, confirmed across multiple independent outlets, not a transfer rumour.

In the Bundesliga, Bayern Munich beat Union Berlin 7-0 with Harry Kane scoring twice, breaking the record for fastest player to reach 100 Bundesliga goals — doing it in his 98th game, beating a mark that had stood since 1977, per the Guardian. This is a completed result rather than a projection, though it is reported by a single outlet in today's feed.

On the transfer side, the only rumour touching these six clubs is BBC's gossip column, which reports Liverpool are watching Netherlands midfielder Kees Smit, valued at £51.5m. This is a single-source, attributed rumour digest, not corroborated by any other outlet in today's feed — treat it as speculation rather than an active deal. No transfer news touched Real Madrid, Man City or PSG in today's feed.
